mapper.select: /* QnA 목록 조회 */ SELECT i.inquiry_id , i.answer_status , c.code_item_name AS category_name , i.title , u.user_name , i.user_id , i.created_at FROM inquiry i LEFT JOIN code_item c ON i.question_type_id = c.code_item_id LEFT JOIN user u ON i.user_id = u.user_id ORDER BY i.created_at DESC
